metadata.article_title: Civil and judicial authorities to act in aid of the Supreme Court

article.title: Civil and judicial authorities to act in aid of the Supreme Court
article.content: All authorities, civil and judicial, in the territory of India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
article.html:
144Civil and judicial authorities to act in aid of the Supreme Court

Article 144 · Part V

All authorities, civil and judicial, in the territory of India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
